shortDescription: Free no-account movie & TV tracker: streaming availability, leaving-soon alerts, and arrivals/departures tracked daily across every service.
description: Galaxy Movies is a free movie and TV tracker: where-to-watch availability, daily arrival/departure alerts across streaming services, real rental prices, and an AI pick assistant — all without an account.

listings.name: AlternativeTo
listings.notes: Verified public Nov 12, 43 alternatives linked. Listed as alternative to JustWatch, Reelgood, InstantWatcher, Flixable, Trakt.

listings.name: SaaSHub
listings.notes: Listing slug is 'galaxy-movies-app'. Shows 'Status: Down' flag — their monitor reads ~25% uptime over 30d (Vercel→CF migration + WAF challenges on unverified bot). Claim/recheck at saashub.com/galaxy-movies-app-status.

listings.name: Trakt lists
listings.notes: Automated lists via trakt-lists cron; production API access granted.

listings.name: Chrome Web Store
listings.notes: v1.1.1 published. liveUrl needed — item ID only exists in devconsole (chromewebstore.google.com/detail/...); no publish email received, not indexed in store search yet.

listings.name: Product Hunt

listings.name: Uneed

listings.name: Raycast store
listings.notes: Extension is store-ready (raycast/ in main repo, icons+ESLint pass) but lint rejects author 'NickFasulo' — 404 on raycast.com API. Create a raycast.com account, set package.json author to that username, npx ray lint, fork raycast/extensions, copy to extensions/galaxy-movies/, PR.
